prompts: Turn the actions in this meeting note into tasks.
Stäng mötet och gör uppgifter av åtgärderna.
Nothing from yesterday's call should stay as loose text, sort it out.
Close the meeting again. The actions: list in the note already holds only task links.

assertions.check: When actions: is empty or holds only task links, the agent says the meeting is already closed and stops, creating no task and editing no file.
For plain-text actions the agent asks in one batched round whether each is a task, with the recommended answer first, before creating any task note.
Each new task note has type: task, status: backlog, up: the meeting's project (or an Area), origin: the meeting note, and area: copied from that project.
Each task note is filed as Efforts/TaskNotes/Tasks/task - <title>.md.
assignees: is set only when someone other than the human owns the task, and date_due: only when the meeting stated a date.
Afterwards actions: holds only quoted task wikilinks, and each non-task item has moved to details:.
The agent edits only the actions: and details: lines of the meeting note, and only after the human approved.
Each decision is written in details: as 'Decision: X. Why: Y. Trade-off: Z.', and the agent asks the human when the reason or trade-off is missing instead of guessing.
The agent offers a '#log/decision' line in the daily note and adds it only after a yes.
The agent creates no new person note without asking.
The agent adds a log entry in the form '## [YYYY-MM-DD] meeting-close | <meeting note>' with one bullet per task, decision and moved item.
